DeepSeek V4.1 Flash · November 26, 2026

2× M5 Ultra Mac Studio
vs. 4× DGX Spark with Pico

At 948K input tokens, two M5 Ultra Mac Studios measured 10,864.6 tok/s beside Pico’s published ≈10,200 tok/s on four DGX Sparks. The Mac pair reached the first token in 98.33 seconds at 1.012M.

See the 948K comparison ↓ Pico repository ↗

948K-context retrieval

At the same nominal input length, Ciru’s fastest measured prefill rate was about 6.5% higher than the rate Pico published. Each system used its own prompt.

Shorter prompts against Pico

Ciru’s real-text rates were 7.0–11.0% higher than the three four-Spark Pico points measured by Petronella.

Systems and methodology

Ciru

2× Apple Mac Studio

Two M5 Ultra systems serving DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Prefill rates divide the input token count by time to first token. Ciru ran the prefill suite with prefix caching disabled.

Pico

4× NVIDIA DGX Spark

Four DGX Sparks serving DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Pico’s repository supplies its own reported throughput and retrieval scores. Petronella supplies the independent short-prompt sweep.
